title: feat(winctl): alt+6/7 = 상단/하단 최대(top/bottom half), Dock reset 6→0 이동
fix(tap): AX 권한 없을 때 fatal 대신 메뉴바 유지+권한 시 자동 무장 (아이콘 항상 표시)
body: tap.m 시작 흐름 재설계 — Accessibility(손쉬운 사용) 권한이 없을 때 fatal 종료하던 것을 폐기하고, 메뉴바 상태아이콘을 AX 권한 게이트보다 먼저 설치한다. arm_event_tap() 헬퍼로 이벤트탭 생성을 분리하고, AXIsProcessTrustedWithOptions(prompt:YES)로 권한 요청 후: 허용됐으면 즉시 무장(PASS armed), 아니면 fatal 대신 3초 주기 recheck 타이머(start_ax_recheck)로 살아서 대기(WAIT ax-permission-pending 센티넬)하다가 사용자가 권한 켜는 즉시 자동 무장+update_menu_states, 재기동/thrash 없음. 배경: 재빌드 바이너리가 linker-signed 라 TCC 권한이 승계 안 돼 앱이 시작 직후 fatal→메뉴바 아이콘 미표시→KeepAlive 38회 재기동 반복하던 문제(ghost 재설치서 발견). 이제 아이콘은 항상 뜨고 권한만 켜면 기능이 살아난다. 센티넬 계약(__AIRGENOME_TAP_RESULT__ 토큰) 유지 — Makefile selftest grep 통과 검증. g_tap_src 전역화(런루프 소스 생성=arm/해제=main). 빌드 클린. 근거: lab full 2모델(fable/sol) 설계 수렴. 후속(별도): install.hexa(L0)/release.yml 가 linker-signed 대신 안정 자체서명 인증서로 서명하게 → 재설치마다 재허용 불필요(승인 필요).

title: refactor architecture
body: Convert ARCHITECTURE.json from legacy schemaVersion 1 (columns-as-string-list name/summary/status/path/note, kind-typed nodes, NO ids, top-level name/note/meta) to the canonical columns/tree schema (schemaVersion 2.0): columns=[name,role,id,detail], single tree root, every node a unique kebab-case id. Lossless port — kind->role, summary->detail (over-300 paragraphs decomposed into one-fact child nodes), status/path inlined or childed, note->child; original top-level summary/note/meta preserved under a new 'project' section (129 nodes). Refresh ARCHITECTURE.html viewer from sidecar canonical. sidecar architecture lint: ok.

title: chore(changelog): CHANGELOG.md -> CHANGELOG.jsonl (append-only JSONL)
body: History SSOT moved from freeform CHANGELOG.md to CHANGELOG.jsonl (newest-first JSONL · {ts,title,body}) via sidecar changelog migrate (airgenome); gate rewired (harness.config lint.changelog.file) + doc pointers updated.

- **docs: ARCHITECTURE.json — decompose over-long dump cells into a real `children` tree (commons c4)** — lossless re-shape, NO content changed. Split the 8 fields that crammed multi-item dumps / ` · `/`; `-joined lists into one short role line on the parent + one child node per item (deeper content unfolds with depth): Tick-pipeline summary (Input/Processing/Output/AdaptiveThrottle), install.hexa summary, native/src summary (8 Obj-C sources → one node each), DESIGN note (5-decision ledger → one node per decision), HUSH note (Applied-mitigations list + ROOT-CAUSE/real-load/hexa-fix/SIP sections + Open-follow-ons list, two of them nested lists), EDID note (Target/Override-file/7-modes/Apply/Limits/Rollback/Implementation/DRM-note), C-PORT note (INVENTORY/DONE-milestones[6 milestones nested]/DEFERRED/Tier/Terminal-status), Harness-engine summary (5-verb quick-reference). Node count 33 → 92. Separators (`; `/` · `/`, `/spaces) preserved by prepending to child fragments; every decomposed parent reconstructs byte-identical to its original field and the whole-tree non-whitespace char multiset is unchanged (0 chars lost). Remaining >250-char cells are all coherent single sentences / @goal prose (root summary/note, meta.verify, Components, Domains, Decision 5, Governance, Docs-discipline, the domain @goal summaries), not dumps. JSON validates (`python3 -m json.tool`); `serve.py` + `ARCHITECTURE.html` viewer still render (HTTP 200, JSON parses). No `.hexa` source touched.
- **docs: ARCHITECTURE.json tree SSOT — retire scattered domain `.md`/`.log.md` + `DOMAINS.tape`** (hexa-codex #161 / anima pattern) — replaced the prose `ARCHITECTURE.md` with a single `ARCHITECTURE.json` tree SSOT (schemaVersion/kind:"architecture-tree"/title/summary/columns + recursive children {name,summary,kind,path,status,note}) + a human viewer `ARCHITECTURE.html` served by `serve.py` (`python3 serve.py`; http, browsers block file:// fetch), both adapted from the anima reference. Folded every scattered domain doc into tree nodes preserving all substance: `AIRGENOME.md`/`.log.md`, `DESIGN.md`/`.log.md` (all 5 design-ledger decisions captured in the DESIGN node note), `HUSH.md`/`.log.md` (mitigation table + root-cause chain + load 82.81→4.46), `EDID.md` (DisplayLink override target + 7 modes + limits), `domains/C-PORT.md`/`.log.md` (winctl-geometry RUNEQ 245/245 + 8-source inventory). `git rm`'d those 10 domain docs. **`DOMAINS.tape` removed** — the `harness domain` feature is retired upstream, so its roster goes too (`domains/` dir now empty). 33 nodes. Repointed live SSOT references: `harness.config.json` docs.architecture → `ARCHITECTURE.json` (+ allowlisted ARCHITECTURE.html); `CLAUDE.md` pointer/tree/docs-discipline → ARCHITECTURE.json + `python3 serve.py`; `.harness/enforcement.json` H-SCATTER-DOC/H-SINGLE-DOC SSOT target → ARCHITECTURE.json; `bin/airgenome` cmd_hush comment → ARCHITECTURE.json. Kept README/CHANGELOG/CLAUDE/LICENSE + the non-domain docs (TAPE-AUDIT.md, LATTICE_POLICY.md, NEXUS.tape). Provenance strings in CHANGELOG history left intact; the full append-only ledgers/logs remain recoverable via `git log` of the deleted files. Verify: JSON valid, serve.py imports clean, domain substance spot-checked present; no `.hexa` source touched (L0 verify gate unaffected).

- **remove: `airgenome flix`** — the DRM-video router (bash `cmd_flix` + `flix_pick_browser` + dispatch/help in `bin/airgenome`, plus the `run.hexa` delegation + help line) is retired. It only automated Chrome's "Use hardware acceleration" toggle in an isolated profile; doing that once directly in the browser (`chrome://settings/system` → hardware acceleration off → Relaunch) is simpler and keeps the user's own profile/login. README's "DRM video + DisplayLink" section now documents the manual Chrome/Edge steps instead of a command; EDID.md pointer updated. The run.hexa arg-index fix, `hexa_bin_path` rename, and upstream hexa `input` builtin fix all stay (real bugs, unrelated to flix).
- **fix(run): subcommand arg index off-by-one — all single-word CLI commands hit help** (L0 `run.hexa`) — the hx shim invokes `hexa <pkg>/run.hexa "$@"`, so `args()` is `[binary, sub, arg1, …]` (subcommand at `a[1]`). `main()` read `sub = a[2]` with a `len(a) < 3` guard — an older hexa args convention that also surfaced the script path. On the current runtime that shifted everything by one, so `airgenome flix`, `airgenome status`, `airgenome doctor`, … (every single-word subcommand) fell through to `print_help()`. Shifted the whole dispatch down by one (`a[2]→a[1]`, `a[3]→a[2]`, `a[4]→a[3]`, guard `<3→<2`). Verified on a compiler rebuilt from upstream: `airgenome flix` → reaches `cmd_flix`; `airgenome status` → status output; bare `airgenome` → help. This is what was blocking `airgenome flix` from ever dispatching after v4.2.2 exposed it.
- **fix(run): expose `flix` on the hx-shim entry** (L0 `run.hexa`) — `cmd_flix` lives in the bash entry `bin/airgenome`, but the installed `airgenome` command is the `run.hexa`-generated shim, so `airgenome flix` resolved to `unknown subcommand` for hx users. Added a `flix`/`netflix` dispatch in `run.hexa main()` that delegates to `<airgenome_root()>/bin/airgenome flix <svc>` (reuses the bash impl, DRY) + a help line. Verified end-to-end on a compiler rebuilt from the upstream `input` fix: `airgenome flix reset` → "wiped isolated profile"; `airgenome flix netflix`/`disney` → reach `cmd_flix` (no-browser guidance on the dev box, which has no Chromium). `script_path()` was rejected (returns the `.hexa-cache` artifact path under `hexa run`); uses `airgenome_root()` like every other subcommand.
- **fix(run): `hexa_bin` → `hexa_bin_path`** (L0 `run.hexa`) — the helper that locates the `hexa` binary was named `hexa_bin`, which now collides with a hexa-lang runtime builtin `hexa_bin(n)` (runtime.c:10905) added upstream. On a fresh `hx install airgenome` the `airgenome` CLI failed to compile with `conflicting types for 'hexa_bin'` (6 errors, build aborted). Renamed the function + all 4 call sites to `hexa_bin_path`. Verified: the `hexa_bin` compile error is gone (build now links past that point). NOTE: end-to-end `hexa run` could not be confirmed on the dev box due to a separate `_input` dyld defect reproducible with a 3-line `input()` file under that box's older `hexa run` fast-path (not airgenome code; `hexa build` codegen emits `hexa_input` correctly) — re-test after `hx install airgenome` on current hexa.
- **`airgenome flix` — Chrome DRM-video router** (supersedes the Safari watch-mode below) — `cmd_flix()` reworked to open the service (Netflix/Disney+/Prime/`<url>`) in a Chromium browser (Google Chrome → Microsoft Edge → Brave) launched with `--disable-gpu` + a seeded `hardware_acceleration_mode=off` pref inside a **dedicated** profile (`~/.airgenome/flix-profile`). Chrome/Edge use Widevine L3, and with HW-accel off they drop the HDCP-hardware requirement → protected video plays **with every DisplayLink screen still on** (720p cap) — the only software fix that keeps multi-screen. Dedicated profile = user's main Chrome settings/login untouched + flag applies reliably; `airgenome flix reset` wipes it. The Safari watch-mode (suspending DisplayLink) was scrapped because it forced external screens dark while watching. Verified: bash -n clean, browser-detect + no-browser error + reset paths exercised.
- **`airgenome flix` — Safari DRM-video watch mode** (superseded same day by the Chrome router above) — initial `cmd_flix()` + dispatch (`flix|netflix`) + help. Root cause (verified, DisplayLink KB 830301): an attached DisplayLink screen has no HDCP path, so macOS blocks FairPlay-protected video (Netflix/Disney+/Prime in **Safari**) on **all** displays session-wide; Safari has no hardware-accel toggle, so the only Safari-compatible remedy is official workaround #1 — temporarily remove the DisplayLink screens. `flix on` software-disconnected DisplayLink (pkill agent, mirroring native `displaylink_stop()`) + opened the service in Safari; `flix off` relaunched the agent. Dropped in favour of the Chrome route, which keeps external screens on.

---

- **harness perfect setup** — brought the repo to full [dancinlab/harness](https://github.com/dancinlab/harness) (hardcore) compliance. Initialized the `.harness-engine` submodule; declared L0 lockdown files (`airgenome/core/airgenome.hexa` · `run.hexa` · `install.hexa`) and a root-scoped `docs` block (`scopeDirs:[""]` + `allow` for README variants and the scatter-named `TAPE-AUDIT.md`) in `harness.config.json`. Rewrote `ARCHITECTURE.md` as the English architecture SSOT (6-axis hexagon · 60-byte genome · Banach 1/3 fixed point) and replaced the `CLAUDE.md → project.tape` symlink with a standard harness `CLAUDE.md` (H1 + description + `## Structure` tree + governance + `## Harness` quick reference; `project.tape` retained). Added SSOT quickref pointers to the remaining root docs. Result: `harness docs check` → `docs: ok`, `harness lint` → `lint: ok`, CLAUDE-MD violations = 0.

---

- **HUSH 도메인 + `airgenome hush`** — macOS 부하 완화 묶음을 `bin/airgenome` `cmd_hush()` 로 통합. `airgenome init` 동행 호출 + `hx install airgenome` 의 `install.hexa` 후행 호출 (single source of truth · idempotent). 항목: XProtect 정의 자동갱신 OFF · 보안 응답 자동설치 OFF · macOS 자동 다운로드·설치 OFF · `AutoInstallProductKeys` 비움 · Spotlight 전역 인덱싱 OFF + mds/mds_stores/mdworker 종료 · `~/.hexa-cache` 인덱싱 차단 · `~/Downloads` quarantine xattr 제거 · Mullvad split-tunnel OFF · `searchpartyuseragent`(Find My) bootout. 진단·배경: `HUSH.md` · `HUSH.log.md`.
- **`AIRGENOME_ROOT` symlink-aware 해석** — `bin/airgenome` 가 `BASH_SOURCE` symlink chain 을 따라가도록 수정. `~/.hx/bin/airgenome` → `~/.hx/packages/airgenome/bin/airgenome` 형태의 hx pkg 설치 경유 호출에서 ROOT 가 잘못 잡혀 `plist source missing` 으로 실패하던 문제 해소.
- **`cmd_hush` — Mission Control "Displays have separate Spaces" ON** — `defaults write com.apple.spaces spans-displays -bool false` 추가. 풀스크린 시 외 모니터가 검정으로 마스킹되던 macOS 기본 동작을 해소 (각 디스플레이가 독립 Space). 적용에는 로그아웃 후 재로그인 필요.
- **`cmd_hush` — Siri/Apple Intelligence/Biome/CoreSpotlight 위성 데몬 disable + UniversalControl OFF** — Siri 비활성 사용자 대상. `launchctl disable gui/UID/` 로 `com.apple.BiomeAgent` · `com.apple.biomesyncd` · `com.apple.suggestd` · `com.apple.corespotlightd` 영구 disable. 이들은 SIP-protected 라 bootout 자체가 차단됨 → 좀비 양산 가능성 0. UniversalControl 은 `defaults write com.apple.universalcontrol Disable -bool true` (Mac↔iPad 마우스 공유 OFF). 모두 다음 로그인부터 적용.
- **`cmd_hush` — Reduce Transparency + Reduce Motion ON** — WindowServer GPU 부하 감축 (blur/투명 합성 · 전환 애니메이션 제거). `com.apple.universalaccess` 는 cfprefsd 독점 관리라 일반 `defaults write` 가 거부됨 → `plutil -replace` 로 plist 직접 수정 후 `killall cfprefsd` flush. 이미 ON 이면 skip (idempotent).
- **Claude Code 통합 폐기** — MCP 서버 · 자체 hook bus(`hooks/`) · `claude_*` 필터 25개 · `cl` 멀티계정 런처 · improve 루프 · AG10 룰 · `~/.claude/settings.json` 렌더러 전면 제거. airgenome 은 Claude Code 하니스에 더 이상 관여하지 않음 — 부하 시 Claude Code CLI 에 자원 우선권을 주는 overload-watch(native)만 예외로 유지.
- **hexa-lang gate 결합 절단** — launchd 하드코딩 `core/hexa-lang/hexa` 경로 → 설치본 `~/.hx/bin/hexa` 로 전환 · `tool/airgenome_init.hexa`(hook/MCP/workspace 부트스트랩) 삭제 · `install.hexa` 는 native 앱 설치만 담당 · hook-watch·tg-bot launchd 잡 제거.
- **규칙 정리** — `l0_paths` 메타데이터 필드를 전 규칙에서 제거 (uchg 동결 메커니즘 폐기에 따른 죽은 필드).
- **hive safety gate 제거** — hive 프로젝트 폐기에 따라 git `core.hooksPath` 훅(커밋 전 개인경로·credential 스캔)을 해제하고 `scripts/safety/` · `state/safety_bypass_audit/` 제거.

- **scope-reduce — mac-local-only** (PR #89) — the cross-host layer removed; airgenome runs mac-local only.
- **project.tape SSOT** — project identity + governance consolidated into `project.tape`; interim Spec Kit scaffolding removed, `AGENTS.tape` archived.
- **DESIGN doc split** — `design.md` → `DESIGN.log.md` (decision audit trail) + `DESIGN.md` live pointer.

- **constitution v1.0.0** — OS Genome Scanner · 6-axis · hexa-native.
